pages.text: 一大早，Sam爸爸把行李箱搬上车，Tina妈妈牵着咘咘的手说："今天我们去一个特别漂亮的地方度假！"咘咘兴奋地跳了起来："度假是什么呀？"
pages.text_en: Early in the morning, Papa Sam loaded the suitcase into the car. Mama Tina held Bubu's hand and said: "Today we're going to a beautiful place for a holiday!" Bubu jumped up excitedly: "What's a holiday?"

pages.text: 车子开了好久好久，窗外的高楼慢慢变成了绿色的山和竹林。终于到了！眼前是一座好大好大的酒店，有喷泉、花园，还有弯弯曲曲的小路。
pages.text_en: They drove for a long, long time. The tall buildings outside the window slowly turned into green mountains and bamboo forests. They finally arrived! A huge resort stood before them, with fountains, gardens, and winding little paths.

pages.text: NOMI和NONO已经在酒店门口等着了。NOMI挥着手说："欢迎欢迎！这里有好多好玩的东西！"NONO站在NOMI头上拍着翅膀："快来快来！"
pages.text_en: NOMI and NONO were already waiting at the hotel entrance. NOMI waved and said: "Welcome, welcome! There are so many fun things here!" NONO stood on NOMI's head, flapping his wings: "Come on, come on!"

pages.text: "看！有小火车！"咘咘发现了一辆彩色的小火车停在花园旁边。一家人赶紧跑过去，坐上了小火车的第一排。
pages.text_en: "Look! A little train!" Bubu spotted a colorful little train parked by the garden. The whole family hurried over and climbed into the front row.

pages.text: "呜——"小火车出发了！它沿着酒店转了一大圈，穿过花园、经过小桥、钻过竹林。咘咘坐在Sam爸爸腿上，风吹着她的耳朵，她开心得一直拍手。
pages.text_en: "Choo choo!" The little train set off! It went all around the resort — through the garden, over a little bridge, and into a bamboo grove. Bubu sat on Papa Sam's lap, the wind blowing her ears, clapping her hands with joy.

pages.text: 下了小火车，咘咘看到一个巨大的蹦蹦床。"我要跳！我要跳！"她踢掉小凉鞋，嗖的一下爬了上去。
pages.text_en: After getting off the train, Bubu spotted a giant trampoline. "I want to jump! I want to jump!" She kicked off her little sandals and scrambled right up.

pages.text: 咘咘在蹦蹦床上跳啊跳，越跳越高！NOMI在旁边帮她数："一百下……两百下……三百下……"咘咘的白毛被风吹得蓬蓬的，她笑着喊："我要跳五百下！"
pages.text_en: Bubu bounced and bounced on the trampoline, higher and higher! NOMI counted from the side: "One hundred... two hundred... three hundred..." Bubu's white fur was all fluffy from the wind. She laughed and shouted: "I'm going to jump five hundred times!"

pages.text: "四百九十八……四百九十九……五百！"咘咘一屁股坐在蹦蹦床上，喘着气说："我做到了！五百下！"Sam爸爸竖起大拇指："我们家咘咘太厉害了！"
pages.text_en: "Four hundred ninety-eight... four hundred ninety-nine... five hundred!" Bubu plopped down on the trampoline, catching her breath: "I did it! Five hundred!" Papa Sam gave a big thumbs up: "Our Bubu is amazing!"

pages.text: 酒店旁边有一条清清的小溪，水浅浅的，刚好到咘咘的脚踝。"好凉快呀！"咘咘踩进水里，溅起一串水花。
pages.text_en: Next to the resort was a clear little stream, shallow enough to reach just Bubu's ankles. "So cool and refreshing!" Bubu stepped in, splashing water everywhere.

pages.text: 咘咘在小溪里踩水、追小鱼、捡石头。NONO飞到水面上，翅膀尖轻轻点了一下水："哎呀，水好冰！"咘咘笑着朝他泼水："NONO你也来玩呀！"
pages.text_en: Bubu splashed in the stream, chased little fish, and collected pretty pebbles. NONO flew over the water and dipped his wing tip in: "Ooh, it's cold!" Bubu laughed and splashed at him: "Come play too, NONO!"

pages.text: Tina妈妈给咘咘拍了好多照片——踩水的、跳蹦蹦床的、坐小火车的。咘咘凑过去看，指着屏幕说："这个好好笑！再拍一张！"
pages.text_en: Mama Tina took lots of photos of Bubu — splashing in the stream, bouncing on the trampoline, riding the little train. Bubu leaned over to look and pointed at the screen: "This one is so funny! Take another one!"

pages.text: 回到房间，咘咘洗完澡躺在大床上，两只眼睛快要睁不开了。Sam爸爸在一边，Tina妈妈在另一边，NOMI轻轻给她盖好被子。"今天好开心……"咘咘小声说着，嘴角翘着，慢慢睡着了。安吉的夜晚好安静，只听得见远处竹林里的风声。
pages.text_en: Back in the room, Bubu lay on the big bed after her bath, her eyes barely staying open. Papa Sam was on one side, Mama Tina on the other, and NOMI gently tucked her in. "Today was so much fun..." Bubu whispered with a little smile, slowly falling asleep. The Anji night was so quiet — only the gentle rustle of wind in the distant bamboo forest.
